# Crontinel docs

> Documentation for Crontinel, monitoring for cron jobs, queues, workers, and background tasks.

## Start

- [Docs home](https://docs.crontinel.com/): Documentation for installing and operating Crontinel

## Guides

- [Billing & Plans](https://docs.crontinel.com/billing/): What each Crontinel plan includes, free tier limits, and how to upgrade
- [FAQ](https://docs.crontinel.com/faq/): Frequently asked questions about Crontinel
- [Installation](https://docs.crontinel.com/installation/): Planned feature. Not available in a released package yet.
- [Introduction](https://docs.crontinel.com/introduction/): What Crontinel is and why it exists
- [Quick Start](https://docs.crontinel.com/quick-start/): Get Crontinel running in under 5 minutes
- [Security](https://docs.crontinel.com/security/): Lock down the Crontinel dashboard, verify webhook signatures, and protect sensitive operational data in your Laravel application.
- [Self-Hosting](https://docs.crontinel.com/self-hosting/): Run the Crontinel SaaS stack on your own server
- [Status Pages](https://docs.crontinel.com/status-page/): Give your users a public status page showing real-time uptime, incident history, and per-monitor health — included free with every Crontinel account.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.crontinel.com/troubleshooting/): Fixes for common Crontinel issues with the dashboard, cron monitor, queue monitor, Horizon, alerts, CLI, and SaaS connection
- [Upgrading](https://docs.crontinel.com/upgrading/): How to upgrade between Crontinel versions, including breaking changes and config updates

## SDKs

- [SDKs & Packages](https://docs.crontinel.com/sdks/): Official Crontinel monitoring packages for every runtime
- [CLI / Docker](https://docs.crontinel.com/sdks/cli/): Monitor any cron job, Docker container, or Kubernetes CronJob with the Crontinel CLI
- [.NET](https://docs.crontinel.com/sdks/dotnet/): Install and configure the Crontinel .NET SDK for .NET applications
- [Go](https://docs.crontinel.com/sdks/go/): Install and configure crontinel/go for Go applications
- [Laravel](https://docs.crontinel.com/sdks/laravel/): Install and configure crontinel/laravel for Laravel applications
- [Node.js / TypeScript](https://docs.crontinel.com/sdks/node/): Install and configure @crontinel/node for Node.js applications
- [PHP](https://docs.crontinel.com/sdks/php/): Install and configure crontinel/php for any PHP application
- [Python](https://docs.crontinel.com/sdks/python/): Install and configure crontinel for Python applications
- [Ruby on Rails](https://docs.crontinel.com/sdks/rails/): Auto-instrument ActiveJob and ActiveScheduler with crontinel-rails
- [Ruby](https://docs.crontinel.com/sdks/ruby/): Install and configure crontinel for Ruby applications
- [Rust](https://docs.crontinel.com/sdks/rust/): Install and configure crontinel-rust for Rust applications

## Monitors

- [Cron Monitor](https://docs.crontinel.com/monitors/cron/): Recording every scheduled command run with exit code and duration
- [Horizon Monitor](https://docs.crontinel.com/monitors/horizon/): Monitoring Laravel Horizon internals with Crontinel
- [Queue Monitor](https://docs.crontinel.com/monitors/queues/): Monitoring queue depths, failed counts, and wait times

## Alerts

- [Alert Channels](https://docs.crontinel.com/alerts/channels/): Planned feature. Not available in a released package yet.
- [CLI Health Check](https://docs.crontinel.com/alerts/cli/): Using php artisan crontinel:check in CI and monitoring pipelines

## AI clients

- [AI Agent Monitoring](https://docs.crontinel.com/mcp/ai-agent-monitoring/): Planned feature. Not available in a released package yet.
- [Claude Code Setup](https://docs.crontinel.com/mcp/claude-code/): Connecting Crontinel to Claude Code via MCP
- [MCP Integration Overview](https://docs.crontinel.com/mcp/overview/): Using Crontinel with AI assistants via Model Context Protocol
- [Available MCP Tools](https://docs.crontinel.com/mcp/tools/): All tools exposed by the Crontinel MCP server

## Agent

- [Agent Guide](https://docs.crontinel.com/agent/guide/): Install and run the Crontinel agent daemon for remote command execution

## Reference

- [REST API Reference](https://docs.crontinel.com/reference/api/): Crontinel REST API for Pro and Team plan users
- [Configuration Reference](https://docs.crontinel.com/reference/configuration/): Complete reference for all Crontinel configuration options, environment variables, and self-hosting setup

## Product

- [Marketing site guide for assistants](https://crontinel.com/llms.txt): Public pages on crontinel.com
- [Hosted app](https://app.crontinel.com/): Sign in to the hosted monitor. Customer data is not part of this guide.
